name: liraasa-workbench
description: Codex, translator, learning system and language-evolution command center for Liraasa 1.0

scripts.build:guide: npm run build:handoff && npm run build:llm && tsx scripts/build_grammar_guide.ts
scripts.validate:1.2: python scripts/validate_1_2.py data/lexicon/liraasa_1_2.json --previous data/lexicon/liraasa_1_1.json --changes data/changes/2026-10-17-grammar-rulings.json data/changes/2026-10-17-lexicon-1-2.json --baseline data/lexicon/lexicon_0_8_rc2.json --out data/lexicon/validation_1_2.json
scripts.validate:2.0: python scripts/validate_2_0.py data/lexicon/liraasa_2_0.json --previous data/lexicon/liraasa_1_2.json --changes data/changes/2026-10-17-grammar-rulings.json data/changes/2026-10-17-lexicon-1-2.json data/changes/2026-10-18-lexicon-2-0.json data/changes/2026-10-18-lexicon-2-0-review.json --baseline data/lexicon/lexicon_0_8_rc2.json --out data/lexicon/validation_2_0.json
scripts.validate:2.1: python scripts/validate_2_1.py data/lexicon/liraasa_2_1.json --previous data/lexicon/liraasa_2_0.json --changes data/changes/2026-10-17-grammar-rulings.json data/changes/2026-10-17-lexicon-1-2.json data/changes/2026-10-18-lexicon-2-0.json data/changes/2026-10-18-lexicon-2-0-review.json data/changes/2026-10-18-lexicon-2-1.json --baseline data/lexicon/lexicon_0_8_rc2.json --out data/lexicon/validation_2_1.json
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test
